entities.query: SELECT ITEM_CODE AS store_code, ITEM_NAME_AR AS name_ar, ITEM_NAME_EN AS name_en, BRAND AS brand, GENERIC_NAME AS generic_name, STRENGTH AS strength, DOSAGE_FORM AS dosage_form, MANUFACTURER AS manufacturer, BARCODE AS barcode, UPDATED_AT AS updated_at FROM YOUR_READ_ONLY_PRODUCT_VIEW
SELECT ITEM_CODE AS store_code, BARCODE AS barcode, UPDATED_AT AS updated_at FROM YOUR_READ_ONLY_BARCODE_VIEW

SELECT ITEM_CODE || ':' || WAREHOUSE_CODE || ':' || NVL(BATCH_NO, '-') AS source_key, ITEM_CODE AS store_code, WAREHOUSE_CODE AS warehouse_code, BATCH_NO AS batch_no, EXPIRY_DATE AS expiry_date, QTY_ON_HAND AS qty_on_hand, SELLING_PRICE AS selling_price, UPDATED_AT AS updated_at FROM YOUR_READ_ONLY_STOCK_VIEW
